limitations: First-order real functional VJP only; no torch.func.vjp, create_graph=True, complex inputs or nested forward AD support.
Default Tensor.numpy has a measurable relative overhead despite a small absolute overhead. No universal performance improvement claim.
VJP timing reference is an unchecked manual0.68AD wrapper, not a preexisting functional API.
The timing environment disappeared after11children. Those results are preserved;7remainingchildren use the samePython and identical sharedNumPy files in a newly recorded environment.
Earlier prototype failures, initial slower implementation and intermediate optimizations are archived as historical evidence, not relabeled as final-source runs.
Module operator serialization covers direct registered function attributes. Arbitrary nested user functions retain ordinary Python pickle limitations.
No GPU backend or new WebGPU throughput claim. Previously qualified opaqueWorker/hostbroker feasibility is separate from this CPU/WASM change.
Archived scripts retain original workspace paths and need the documented dependencies and path adjustment for replay.
Local validation does not imply main adoption, CI execution, release or deployment.
